title: Follow the job, end to end.
subtitle: One request crosses three participants. Follow the calls, the internal work, and the response back to the client.
assumptions: A simplified synchronous job request: the API waits for the worker result.
The self-message represents internal processing, not another network call.
Playback duration is illustrative, not measured latency.

scenarios.label: Successful job
scenarios.description: The worker completes the job, and the API returns its result.

steps.title: Submit the input
steps.detail: The client sends a job request to the API.

steps.title: Delegate the work
steps.detail: The API forwards the job to a worker and waits for the result.

steps.title: Process inside the worker
steps.detail: The self-message shows local processing. No other participant receives this message.

steps.title: Return the job result
steps.detail: The worker sends the result back to the API. The dashed arrow preserves the response style in the source.

steps.title: Respond to the client
steps.detail: The API returns 200 OK with the result. The request is now complete.
